ThornThicket_Text_Npc0.en: HERACROSS and PINSIR live here.\nBring a good ball!
ThornThicket_Text_Npc0.fr: SCARHINO et SCARABRUTE vivent ici.\nApporte une bonne ball !

ThornThicket_Text_Npc1.en: SCYTHER and SHUCKLE are shy, but\nworth the wait.
ThornThicket_Text_Npc1.fr: INSÉCATEUR et CARATROC sont\ntimides, mais valent l'attente.

ThornThicket_Text_Quest0_AfterT.en: No more bugs on my sandwich.

ThornThicket_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: Bugs keep eating my lunch. Bring 2\nREPELs and I pay you!
ThornThicket_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Les insectes mangent sans cesse mon\ndéjeuner. Apporte 2 REPOUSSES et je\lte paie !

ThornThicket_Text_Quest0_Done.en: Peace at last! Take this SILVER\nPOWDER.
ThornThicket_Text_Quest0_Done.fr: Enfin la paix ! Prends cette POUDRE\nARGENT.

ThornThicket_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
ThornThicket_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein ! Fais de la\nplace et reviens me voir.

ThornThicket_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

ThornThicket_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.

ThornThicket_Text_TopazeFindFull.en: Something shines here, but your BAG\nis full.
ThornThicket_Text_TopazeFindFull.fr: Quelque chose brille ici, mais ton\nSAC est plein.
